people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Yahweh remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
translations.bsb: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;
translations.kjv: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
translations.asv: Jehovah hath been mindful of us; he will bless us: He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
